run_mnist_classifier: run the MNIST classifier example to train a LeNet-300-100 MLP on handwritten digit images
build_mlp_network: build a LeNet-300-100 MLP network using Haiku Sequential with Flatten and Linear layers
load_mnist_dataset: load the MNIST dataset using TensorFlow Datasets with shuffling and batching support
train_network_with_adam: train a Haiku network using the Adam optimizer with L2 regularization and exponential moving average
evaluate_classification_accuracy: evaluate classification accuracy on train and test splits using JIT-compiled evaluation
